The Slow Web

Why pages got heavier and what we can do about it

Issue 42: images, fonts, and the hidden cost of convenience

Jordan Price · Sep 18, 2026

The median web page today downloads more data than an entire operating system did twenty years ago.1

Most of that weight comes from images and scripts that nobody asked for.

Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts.

Three things you can try this week

  1. Serve images in a modern format and at the size they are displayed.

  2. Limit yourself to two font weights.

  3. Measure before and after every change.

1

Based on public crawl data collected in early 2026.
